sections.What we use it for:
Files under `template/` and `.schema/` cite the documentation site by URL, and every corpus that took the framework keeps a copy of them. A page that moves would break each of those links in every such corpus, and no check here reads an external URL. The plugin kept each old URL working.

`redirect_maps` in `mkdocs.yml` lists each moved page and the page that replaced it. The page it wrote kept the anchor. `NavigationTests` in `kac.tests` fails a redirect whose target the nav does not list.
sections.Status: [tol-zensical](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/ff4b98f7e832260c4bde38430bf3d834389bc50c/examples/dog-fooding/tools/docs/zensical.md) builds the redirect pages itself, from the same `redirect_maps` key, and keeps the anchor the same way. The approval stopped at 1.2.2, because the ProperDocs project publishes every release from 1.2.3, and that release requires `properdocs`, a fork of MkDocs.
